name: t105_98_7_d8_stretch
headline: AI Detected
windows: One more thing about telling whether it helped. A few hours of feeling lighter, with the old feeling back the same day, is a few hours of relief. I’d take that! I just wouldn’t call the problem solved from it, or give the exercise all the credit, especially if you also slept well for once.
Jot down what changed and how long it lasted if you want, and then leave it alone.
I really don’t know, and I’d be suspicious of anyone who promises you a number, including you, since some things shift in a day and some take about as long as learning guitar.

If it’s making things worse, or you just can’t do it right now, I’d change course sooner (stopping counts). Not wanting to do it anymore is a reason too, but if that “nope” sounds like a part of you that’s trying to protect you, I’d hear it out first.
If it still says no, that’s your answer.

And if you keep following the reparenting steps correctly without getting the expected results, consider if you have a unique case these steps don’t match yet. Maybe you’ll find something that works better for you, or you can ask me what I’d do for this case, or ask a therapist you work with.
Either way, I’d like to hear about it!
Sometimes a session goes great, and a few days later you’re skipping lunch and saying yes to everything again. Going deeper next time won’t fix that.

You just haven’t brought any of it out with you yet. Whatever you did for your little one in there, try a tiny bit of it out here, like texting a friend that you’re having a rough day instead of saying you’re fine.

name: t105_98_2_d3
headline: Human Written
windows: After the day, look at what actually happened. Say you did the Protector action(s) and you don’t feel any better, or you feel worse. Standing up for yourself can do that at first. Not doing it is harder to figure out. Fear is the first guess. But did you know how to do it, and why?
Were you worn out? Maybe whoever said they’d help couldn’t make it. 🤗
